verdict.rationale: LightSprint is a SaaS platform for agentic software delivery, so an interactive API reference is a fair thing for a buyer to ask about. The evidence pack never mentions a public API reference or runnable examples, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt on docs.lightsprint.ai all returned 404. The docs only describe the product UI, previews, integrations and Review Hub workflows.
